headline: Jammy The Bull ( OTF JAM) speaks out ahead of verdict day. He says Lil Durk @lildurk sent
body: Jammy The Bull ( OTF JAM) speaks out ahead of verdict day. He says Lil Durk @lildurk sent him off.. told him to do a m*rder and when Durk found out the cops was onto em.. he ain’t even warn em. Questions how Durk can be a leader in OTF when he ain’t ever been a soldier and claims money is what put Durk in his position.
